title: Pitch-class Steering for Diffusion-based Music Generation via Latent-space Probes
abstract: arXiv:2609.04516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work on controllable music generation has focused on autoregressive models, leaving diffusion-based systems comparatively underexplored. We present a lightweight method for steering the pitch content of audio produced by Stable Audio Open, a latent diffusion model for music synthesis. A small convolutional probe containing approximately 125k parameters is trained to decode frame-level pitch-class activations from the model's variational autoencoder latent space, using paired audio and MIDI data. At inference time, the frozen probe serves as a differentiable loss function: its gradient with respect to the denoising latent is used to nudge generation toward a user-specified pitch-class sequence, requiring no retraining or architectural modification of the base model. translated_title: 基于潜空间探针的扩散式音乐生成音级引导方法
translated_abstract: 近期关于可控音乐生成的研究主要集中于自回归模型，而基于扩散模型的系统则相对缺乏探索。我们提出了一种轻量级方法，用于引导Stable Audio Open（一种用于音乐合成的潜在扩散模型）所生成音频的音高内容。我们利用配对的音频与MIDI数据，训练了一个仅约12.5万参数的小型卷积探针，用于从模型的变分自编码器潜空间中解码帧级音级激活。在推理阶段，冻结的探针被用作可微损失函数：其相对于去噪潜变量的梯度被用于将生成过程引向用户指定的音级序列，无需对基础模型进行重新训练或架构修改。在涵盖9个文本提示和3个目标旋律的27次评估试验中，探针引导的生成相比无引导基线将旋律连贯性提升了2.4倍。
tldr: 该论文提出一种轻量级方法，通过训练小型卷积探针解析扩散模型的潜空间音级信息，并在推理时将其作为可微损失函数引导Stable Audio Open按照用户指定的音级序列生成音乐，无需重训练或修改模型即可使旋律连贯性提升2.4倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight method that trains a small convolutional probe to decode pitch-class information from the latent space of a diffusion model and uses it as a differentiable loss at inference time to steer Stable Audio Open toward user-specified pitch-class sequences, improving melodic coherence by 2.4x without retraining or architectural modification.
